theory.title: At the Playground: words and simple English
theory.explanation: Aprende diez acciones del parque infantil. Descubre cómo dar instrucciones sencillas y expresar lo que puedes hacer con can.
theory.tip: Say each new word aloud, then use it in a short sentence.

phrases.spanish: Salta por encima de la línea.

phrases.note: Después de can, el verbo no lleva -s.
Do not + verbo base forma una orden negativa.

phrases.spanish: Avanza dando saltitos al ritmo de la música.

phrases.english: A command starts with a base verb.
phrases.spanish: Una orden empieza con un verbo en forma base.
phrases.note: Run, jump y stop son imperativos.

grammar.note: El imperativo usa el verbo base.

grammar.spanish: Salta por encima de la línea.

grammar.english: Do not run on the wet floor.
grammar.spanish: No corras en el suelo mojado.
grammar.note: Orden negativa: do not + verbo base.

grammar.english: A command starts with a base verb.
grammar.spanish: Una orden empieza con un verbo en forma base.
Avanza dando saltitos al ritmo de la música.

content.passage: On Saturday, Mia goes to the playground with her brother Leo. They run to the swings and jump over a small line. Leo can climb the steps and go down the slide. Mia likes to swing. They play with a ball, but they stop when their mum calls. Then they walk home together.

items.prompt: When does Mia go to the playground?
What does Mia like to do?

items.modelAnswer: I can hop on one foot.

content.audio: tts:en-GB:At the playground, I run to the gate. I jump over a small line. I climb the steps. I swing on the seat. I go down the slide. I play with my friends. When Mum says stop, I stop. Then I walk slowly. I hop on one foot. I skip to the music.
